name: fmp_etf_country_weights
description:
Country allocation of one ETF from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP): weight per country.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/etf-country-weightings as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ETF ticker, sent as given, e.g. VEA).
Sector mix: fmp_etf_sector_weights; individual holdings: fmp_etf_holdings.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"symbol": "VEA"}
